excerpt.zh: 外层船体板需要在持续的恒星照射下进行热荷载测试。为确保安全，朝向恒星一侧的所有舷窗都将被遮蔽。
excerpt.en: The outer hull plating requires thermal load testing under sustained stellar exposure. All viewports on the starward side will be shuttered for safety.
